title: eulophia stenophylla
intro: Eulophia stenophylla, commonly known as the terrestrial orchid, is a plant species belonging to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Eulophia stenophylla include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These constituents have been shown to possess antioxidant and cytoprotective effects, highlighting the plant's potential in traditional medicine.
